channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Nunes diz que Flávio “será eleito” e critica Haddad e Tebet
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) as a likely winner in the 2026 presidential election, citing Lula’s alleged fiscal irresponsibility and high inflation. He also backed Tarcísio de Freitas’ re-election as governor and criticized Fernando Haddad and Simone Tebet, doubting their qualifications and commitment to São Paulo.

item.title: Ao marcar sessão do Congresso com pauta única, Alcolumbre manda recado de que não criará CPI do Master
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre announced a congressional session on April 30 with a single agenda item: voting on President Lula's veto of the dosimetry bill, which reduces sentences for Bolsonaro and coup plotters. This move is seen as signaling that he will not allow the reading of requests to establish a CPI on Master, as opposition and even government allies believe Daniel Vorcaro’s plea deal makes a congressional investigation unnecessary. Alcolumbre is attempting to balance both sides, having referred Jorge Messias’ STF nomination to the CCJ for an April 29 hearing, indicating a strategy to appease all factions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro acena ao agro, defende marco temporal e sugere que indígenas possam criar gado e explorar minério em terras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL pre-candidate for president, advocated for the indigenous land timeframe policy during a speech at ExpoGrande in Campo Grande (MS), arguing that indigenous communities should have autonomy to decide on cattle ranching, mining, and tourism in their territories to generate royalties and prosperity. He accused the Lula government of being hostile to agribusiness and claimed the timeframe would end 'legal insecurity' in indigenous lands, assigning Congress the role of restoring constitutional order.

item.title: Três militares condenados por trama golpista são presos; dois estão foragidos
item.description: The Brazilian Army carried out arrest warrants on Friday (10) against three of the seven military personnel convicted by the STF for their role in the 'Nucleus 4' coup plot: reserve Major Ângelo Denicoli, Subtenent Giancarlo Rodrigues, and Lieutenant Colonel Guilherme Almeida. Two convicted individuals remain at large: Colonel Reginaldo Abreu (in the U.S.) and Carlos César Moretzsohn Rocha, president of Instituto Voto Legal (in the UK). Federal Police agent Marcelo Bormevet has been imprisoned since 2024. Military personnel are held in military facilities, while civilians are sent to civilian prisons.

item.title: Governo Lula anunciará parceria com EUA contra crime organizado
item.description: The Lula government will announce on Friday, April 10, 2026, the 'Brazil-U.S. Action Against Organized Crime,' a partnership between Brazil's Federal Revenue and U.S. Customs and Border Protection to intercept illicit shipments of weapons and drugs. The announcement will be made by Finance Minister Dario Durigan at the Ministry of Finance in Brasília, as part of the bilateral dialogue between President Lula and U.S. President Donald Trump.

item.title: Kassab cita inexperiência de Flávio Bolsonaro e o compara com Caiado: 'Experiência é fundamental'
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, emphasized the importance of political experience by comparing Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, both pre-candidates for president, stating Caiado has the necessary experience for the role. The remarks were made at an Esfera Brasil dinner in São Paulo, attended by PT leaders and other politicians, and echoed Caiado’s earlier analogy comparing political leadership to choosing an experienced doctor. Kassab also confirmed exchanging Easter greetings with Fernando Haddad but reiterated the PSD’s firm support for Tarcísio de Freitas’s re-election in São Paulo.

item.title: Exército prende três militares condenados pelo STF em processo da trama golpista
item.description: The Army arrested three military personnel convicted by the Supreme Federal Court (STF) for being part of Nucleus 4 of the coup plot, which aimed to prevent Lula's inauguration and keep Bolsonaro in power. The detained include reserve Major Ângelo Denicoli (17 years), Subtenent Reginaldo Abreu (15 years and six months), and Lieutenant Colonel Guilherme Almeida (13 years and six months), accused of spreading disinformation and conducting virtual attacks to pressure the Armed Forces into supporting the institutional rupture.

item.title: Justiça mantém liminar que suspendeu imposto de 12% sobre petróleo
item.description: The Federal Justice upheld the injunction suspending the 12% tax on crude oil exports by five multinational companies (Shell, Equinor, Petrogal, TotalEnergies and Repsol Sinopec), established by MP 1.340/2026 of the Lula government. Judge Carmen Silva Lima de Arruda of the TRF-2 ruled there is no imminent risk of irreparable harm in maintaining the suspension, and the government failed to prove concrete danger, deferring merit analysis to a final ruling. The tax, intended to counter international oil price spikes and shield domestic diesel and food prices, was deemed potentially revenue-driven and unconstitutional by the lower court judge.

item.title: Lula minimiza 'conflito de interesses' de Moraes no caso Master e deveria aconselhar PGR a não se omitir, diz Transparência Internacional
item.description: Transparency International acknowledged Lula's advice to Moraes to recuse himself in the Master Bank case but criticized the president for downplaying the conflict of interest involving the minister's family law firm, which received a suspicious R$129 million contract from the bank. The NGO argues that recusal alone does not address the systemic lobbying issue and accuses Lula of prioritizing political distancing over integrity, harming the STF's image and his own government.

item.title: Governo anuncia parceria entre Receita Federal e agência de fronteiras dos Estados Unidos para combate ao crime organizado
item.description: The government announced a partnership between the Brazilian Federal Revenue Service and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to combat transnational organized crime, focusing on intercepting illicit shipments of weapons and drugs. The initiative, called Project MIT, aligns with the dialogue between Presidents Lula and Trump and comes amid speculation that the U.S. may designate Brazilian criminal factions PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, although the U.S. government has not officially stated its position on the matter.

item.title: Conheça os indicados para o STF desde a Constituição
item.description: The text lists the nominees for the Supreme Federal Court (STF) since the 1988 Constitution, organized by president, highlighting the pending nomination of Jorge Messias by Lula in 2026, awaiting Senate vote. It outlines the nomination process, requiring presidential proposal and Senate approval by absolute majority.

item.title: Charge do JCaesar: 10 de abril
item.description: The JCaesar cartoon published on April 10, 2026, satirizes the political relationship between Jair Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, using humor to comment on tensions and dynamics in Brazil’s electoral landscape. The image, published in VEJA, reflects the climate of polarization and confrontation between the country’s two main political figures, common in political cartoons of the period.

item.title: Trama golpista: militares presos nesta sexta cumprirão pena em Brasília e Vila Velha (ES); coronel está foragido
item.description: Three military members of the 4th nucleus of the coup plot were arrested on Friday (10) to serve their sentences in Army battalions in Brasília and Vila Velha (ES): reserve Major Ângelo Denicoli (Vila Velha), Subtenente Giancarlo Rodrigues, and Tenente-Coronel Guilherme Almeida (both in Brasília). Colonel Reginaldo Abreu remains at large. The battalions have previously held other individuals convicted for involvement in the January 8 coup attempt.

item.title: JOTA Principal: STF adia decisão sobre RJ e Alcolumbre destrava pautas no Senado
item.description: The STF postponed its decision on the format of the interim gubernatorial election in Rio de Janeiro, with Justices Nunes Marques and André Mendonça showing alignment in rejecting rulings that would benefit political factions not aligned with their interests, signaling an independent stance ahead of the 2026 elections. In the Senate, the confirmation hearing for Jorge Messias, Lula’s nominee to the STF, was finally scheduled for April 29 in the CCJ, breaking months of delay.

item.title: O isolamento de Lula a seis meses da eleição
item.description: Lula is politically isolated six months ahead of the 2026 presidential election, with his coalition weakened by ministerial reshuffles and a lack of dialogue with Congress and key economic sectors. His inner circle consists mainly of left-wing advisers, limiting his ability to reverse negative polling trends.

item.title: Exército prende três militares condenados no núcleo 4 na trama golpista; 2 estão foragidos
item.description: The Brazilian Army arrested three military personnel convicted by the STF in Nucleus 4 of the coup plot: reserve major Ângelo Denicoli, subtenent Giancarlo Rodrigues, and lieutenant-colonel Guilherme Almeida. Of the seven convicted, two remain fugitives: Colonel Reginaldo Abreu (in the U.S.) and Carlos César Moretzsohn Rocha, president of Instituto Voto Legal (in the UK). The group was accused of using the Abin to spread false information and destabilize democratic institutions.

item.title: ‘Investigação pressupõe indício de crime’, diz Paulo Gonet sobre cobranças para investigar STF
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet states that investigations require evidence of a crime, dismissing pressure to probe Supreme Court ministers based on Daniel Vorcaro’s claims, the jailed Banco Master owner seeking a plea deal. Gonet insists Vorcaro must substantiate his allegations with proof, and the PGR will not act on hearsay or incomplete evidence, maintaining the same rigor applied in the Bolsonaro jewelry case. Any investigation into STF ministers would require authorization from the Court’s plenary.

item.title: Kassab reafirma apoio do PSD a Tarcísio em SP
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, reaffirmed his party's support for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election campaign in São Paulo, despite having resigned from his position as secretary in the state government and the PSD not being part of the main ticket. He emphasized that the backing is a firm, pre-established decision by the party, even as he engages in dialogue with former minister Fernando Haddad (PT), to whom he returned an Easter greeting. The PSD remains committed to Tarcísio's campaign, although it was excluded from the coalition after Vice Governor Felício Ramuth moved to the MDB.

item.title: O “sonho de consumo” de Flávio para vice
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) is a 'dream come true' as a vice-presidential running mate, joking that he calls her 'vozinha' due to her resemblance to his grandmother. The statement, made on Thursday, the 9th, suggests a potential political alliance between the two pré-candidates.

item.title: Delação de Camisotti mostra entranhas da corrupção no INSS no governo Lula
item.description: The plea bargain of businessman Maurício Camisotti exposes a corruption scheme within the INSS during Lula's government, involving bribes paid to PDT politicians, ministers, congressional figures, and Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lula's son. Camisotti provided documents linking the scheme to Antônio Carlos Camilo, known as 'Careca do INSS', and detailed money laundering through a São Paulo law firm, intensifying pressure for convictions at the STF.

item.title: Cobrado por 'faxina' na herança de Castro, Ricardo Couto discute 'plenos poderes' com Fachin
item.description: Rio de Janeiro's interim governor, Ricardo Couto, is being urged by STF President Edson Fachin to exercise 'full powers' to audit contracts from the previous Cláudio Castro administration and dismantle the politicization of the state machine, including the Political Representation Secretariat nicknamed 'Sergipe Republic'. Their meeting on Friday (10) will address this issue, while the STF will decide on April 8 how the next governor of RJ will be elected.

item.title: Governo estuda liberar mais R$ 10 bi do FGTS para dívidas de cartão
item.description: The government is studying two provisional measures to release R$10 billion from the FGTS to pay off credit card debts, plus R$7 billion for 10 million workers dismissed between 2020 and 2025. The initiative aims to reduce household indebtedness, which reached 80.4% in March according to the CNC.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: President Lula states that, regardless of who wins the elections, he will respect the democratic outcome, even if it is his greatest political opponent. He emphasizes that his duty is to ensure the winner’s inauguration, placing the presidential sash on whoever is legitimately elected.

item.title: PT desiste de candidatura própria no RS após pressão de Lula
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) abandoned its own candidacy for Rio Grande do Sul governor in 2026 under direct pressure from President Lula, choosing to support Juliana Brizola (PDT) as the gubernatorial candidate, with Edegar Pretto (PT) as potential running mate. The move sparked internal dissent, with figures like Valter Pomar accusing the PT of authoritarian intervention, while José Dirceu defended it as a legitimate national alliance. PSOL threatens to exit the coalition over disagreement with the PDT pact.

item.title: Ricardo Nunes: “Flávio será eleito”
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes declares that Flávio Bolsonaro will be elected president and pledges full support for his campaign, citing his success in security, food security, and public transportation in the city. He criticizes Lula’s government over scandals like Banco Master and INSS, claiming they damage the STF’s credibility and harm the poor, and believes Minister André Mendonça’s actions could restore public trust in the judiciary.

item.title: Com Lula estagnado, PT financia bombardeio contra Flávio Bolsonaro nas redes
item.description: The PT spent R$ 378,000 on Instagram and Facebook ads attacking Flávio Bolsonaro, labeling him a 'traitor of the homeland' due to his ties with the U.S., linking him to the Banco Master scandal, fuel price increases, and the potential end of Pix. The campaign also claims the PL opposes income tax exemptions up to R$ 5,000 and the end of the 6×1 work scale. This strategy may violate TSE rules prohibiting negative ad boosting, even in the pre-campaign period.

item.title: Embate entre Nikolas e Eduardo cria turbulência à direita em momento crucial para Flávio
item.description: The public feud between Eduardo Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira, two of Brazil's most-voted federal deputies in history, has created turmoil on the right at a critical moment for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign. Eduardo accused Nikolas of mockery, disrespect, and using his social media algorithm to amplify opponents of Bolsonarism, after Nikolas shared a profile that does not support Flávio in the first round. The exchange, sparked by Nikolas' post about Pix and Lula, exposed internal fractures within the Bolsonaro clan and threatened right-wing unity amid a technical tie with Lula in the polls.

item.title: Alto custo
item.description: Lula's government is planning Desenrola 2.0, a new national debt renegotiation program targeting households, individuals, and micro, small, and medium businesses, as an electoral strategy to counter high rejection rates. Led by Finance Minister Dario Durigan, the initiative will cost over R$400 million and unfold amid record interest rates, modest GDP growth projections (1.5% in 2026 by OECD), and accusations that Lula is spending more to get re-elected than he criticized Bolsonaro for.

item.title: Peregrinação de Messias por votos incluiu até encontro com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Jorge Messias, a political candidate for the 2026 elections, undertook a pilgrimage to gather votes and reduce rejection, including a meeting in December last year with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a critic of his nomination to the STF. The goal was to gain Senate support, including from the opposition to Lula's government. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Saiba quem é Samara Martins, pré-candidata à Presidência pelo UP
item.description: Samara Martins, a 38-year-old dentist and presidential pre-candidate for the Unidade Popular (UP), was unanimously approved by the party's National Directorate in February 2025. She is the first Black woman to run for president under the UP banner, works in the SUS in Rio Grande do Norte, serves as the party's national vice-president, and was the vice-presidential candidate in 2022 alongside Leo Péricles. Her campaign centers on socialist ideals, opposing outsourcing, gig economy exploitation, violence against women and Black people, and advocating for workers', women's, and Black communities' rights.

item.title: Por que o favoritismo de Lula na corrida presidencial está sob ameaça
item.description: Lula faces declining popularity, with disapproval surpassing approval, pressured by the cost of living, lack of new government initiatives, and a more competitive opposition led by Flávio Bolsonaro, who in some polls is already ahead of him in second-round simulations. His re-election strategy, relying on an outdated legacy, fails to connect with emerging voter blocs like small entrepreneurs, who lean toward the right. While allies blame government communication, analysis points to structural failures in leadership and adaptation to the current context.

item.title: Lula reativa estratégia de mostrar vitalidade após especulações de que pode desistir de reeleição
item.description: President Lula has revived his strategy of showcasing vitality on social media, sharing videos and images of himself exercising and running up the Planalto Palace ramp, amid speculation about a potential withdrawal from the 2026 re-election race. Although he stated in an interview that he has not yet decided to run, allies say he intends to follow PT procedures and is unlikely to abandon the candidacy. Financial market actors and Haddad allies have speculated about his exit, but Haddad denies any interest in replacing Lula for president, focusing instead on the São Paulo gubernatorial race.

item.title: Carta ao Leitor: Discussões necessárias
item.description: The text emphasizes the importance of political debates, citing the historic 1960 Kennedy-Nixon clash as an example of how television performance can influence elections. In Brazil, with the 2026 election approaching, debates are gaining even more relevance amid misinformation and AI use. TV VEJA+ will play a central role in broadcasting state and national debates, including a potential presidential showdown between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Aliados veem briga entre Eduardo e Nikolas com 'potencial catastrófico'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign team views the feud between Eduardo Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira as potentially catastrophic for their chances of winning Minas Gerais, a state deemed essential to victory in the presidential election. They stress that Nikolas Ferreira's support is crucial in the state, and that Eduardo's interference is undermining the necessary political coordination.

item.title: Julgamento sobre eleição no Rio evidencia racha profundo no Supremo
item.description: The STF’s ruling on whether Rio de Janeiro’s governor should be elected directly or indirectly exposed a deep rift among the justices, reflecting institutional instability fueled by scandals involving relatives of magistrates and the Master Bank. The debate over direct versus indirect elections revealed not only legal disagreements but also political and ethical tensions within the Court.

item.title: O vexame de 'lady' Janja com a paca para Lula
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva has faced criticism for statements and behaviors deemed inappropriate for her position, including an incident involving the term 'paca' that caused institutional embarrassment. These episodes have been seen as damaging to the Presidency's image and contrary to the seriousness expected of the role. Media and political sectors have highlighted them as examples of lack of discretion and respect for the office.

item.title: Flávio diz que Tereza Cristina como vice é “sonho de consumo”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said having Tereza Cristina as his running mate would be the "dream come true for everyone," but did not confirm the choice, postponing the decision. He praised her agro background and alignment with his agenda, including judiciary reform and lowering the age of criminal responsibility. Tereza Cristina has stated she is ready to serve as vice president.

item.title: O cabo de guerra nos bastidores do Supremo em torno da eleição no Rio
item.description: The impasse over the succession in Rio de Janeiro's state government has sparked a conflict among Supreme Court justices, with Alexandre de Moraes advocating for a direct election — aligned with Eduardo Paes' PSD — while Cármen Lúcia supports an indirect election. The dispute, intensified by the Banco Master case, reveals ideological divisions within the Court regarding the process for selecting Rio's next governor.

item.title: Haddad busca apoio de Kassab contra Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo, said he wants to talk to Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, to hear his assessment of the state, though he only received a brief, non-committal response. Kassab reiterated his support for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, ruling out an alliance with Haddad while expressing openness to discussing public policy. Haddad stressed that his priority is to develop a solid government plan before negotiating alliances, citing concerns over education, health, security, and investment in São Paulo.

item.title: Lindbergh e Janones xingam Flávio em vídeo: “Vagabundo”
item.description: Government deputy leader Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) and federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) released a video attacking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), calling him a 'vagabond' and questioning his ties to militias and real estate holdings. The video was a response to Flávio’s threat to sue them, claiming the Lula government had assembled a 'team' to attack him with false narratives. Janones is also facing a criminal complaint at the STF for previously calling Jair Bolsonaro a 'vagabond', 'thief', and 'pervert' in social media videos.

item.title: Por que um candidato com mais votos pode não se eleger deputado
item.description: In Brazil's proportional system for federal deputies, election depends on both individual votes and the party or federation's total performance. A candidate can receive more votes than another and still not be elected if their group fails to reach the electoral quotient needed to secure sufficient seats. This occurred in 2022 with Rosa Neide (PT) in Mato Grosso and José Serra (PSDB) in São Paulo, while candidates with fewer individual votes, like Tiririca (PL), were elected due to their parties' strong overall performance.

item.title: Davide Ancelotti diz que Neymar ainda tem chances de ir à Copa: 'Tem tempo para fazer seu melhor'
item.description: Davide Ancelotti, assistant coach of the Brazil national team and son of Carlo Ancelotti, said Neymar still has time to recover and earn a spot in the 2026 World Cup squad, emphasizing that the final list will be released on May 18 and the decision rests with the head coach. He also highlighted Chelsea forward Estêvão as a potential surprise inclusion, noting that injured players could be called up if they recover in time for Brazil’s opening match against Morocco on June 13.

item.title: PL quer punição a Lula por suposta propaganda eleitoral em evento oficial no Rio
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) filed a representation with the TSE against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, alleging premature electoral propaganda during an institutional event in March in Rio de Janeiro. The PL claims Lula used the event to promote his image with electoral intent, violating Brazilian electoral law. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Base governista reage a falas de Flávio Bolsonaro e prepara contraproposta sobre exploração de minerais críticos
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) is preparing a bill to create the Brazilian Company for Rare Earth Mining (TerraBras), establish a production-sharing regime with the Union modeled on the pre-salt, and ban exports of critical minerals to countries at war, in response to remarks by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at CPAC in the United States.

item.title: Entrevista: Lula 'demorou demais' a decidir sobre posição do PT no Rio Grande do Sul, reclama ex-governador Tarso Genro
item.description: Former governor Tarso Genro criticized President Lula for taking too long to define the PT's position in Rio Grande do Sul after the withdrawal of Edegar Pretto's pre-candidacy, stating that the national leadership pushed for support of Juliana Brizola to strengthen Lula's re-election bid, despite viewing the decision as a political loss locally. He denied that intervention occurred in the state party directory, emphasizing that the guidance aimed at unity around Lula's re-election, and argued that Edegar would have been a strong candidate due to his 2022 electoral performance and social articulation.

item.title: Deputados da Alerj reagem à fala de Gilmar Mendes sobre 'mesada do jogo do bicho': 'Grande desconforto'
item.description: STF Minister Gilmar Mendes stated that 32 or 34 deputies of the Alerj received a 'mesada' from the illegal gambling game 'jogo do bicho' based on information from the PF director-general, sparking strong backlash in the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly. Deputies called the accusation grave and unfounded, causing significant discomfort amid institutional fragility, as the Alerj denies any illicit ties and demands evidence for such claims.

item.title: Episódio 'Bessias', caso Master e proximidade com Lula: o que a oposição deve explorar na sabatina de Messias
item.description: The sabatina of Jorge Messias for the STF will become a key political battleground, with the opposition focusing on his proximity to Lula, the 'Bessias' nickname tied to intercepted conversations in the Lava-Jato operation, and his role in the AGU regarding the Banco Master investigation and parliamentary amendments. The goal is to challenge his institutional independence, given his current position as Attorney General of the Union places him at the center of conflicts between the Executive, Legislative, and Judicial branches.

item.title: Jogo Político: Caiado, Kassab e a conta que não fecha sobre quanto vai custar a candidatura presidencial do PSD
item.description: The article examines the financial and strategic challenges facing the PSD’s potential 2026 presidential bid, focusing on the difficulties Ronaldo Caiado and Gilberto Kassab encounter in aligning funding, endorsements, and electoral viability. The 'unbalanced accounts' refer to the gap between projected campaign costs and the party’s actual ability to raise funds and mobilize support, amid a fragmented center-right and lack of a consensus candidate.

item.title: Flávio defende que indígenas criem gado e diz que PT persegue agro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) advocated for indigenous autonomy to raise cattle and exploit their lands, criticized the PT for persecuting agribusiness, and supported the temporal landmark. He also attacked the MST and Minister Marina Silva, claiming the Lula government hates private property.

item.title: Após quatro votos por eleições indiretas, STF suspendeu julgamento sobre sucessão no Rio; entenda situação no estado
item.description: The STF suspended the trial on the method of electing the governor of Rio de Janeiro after four votes favored indirect election (by state deputies) and one vote supported direct election. Minister Flávio Dino requested more time to await the TSE’s joint decision on the ineligibility of Governor Cláudio Castro. In the meantime, the president of the TJ-RJ, Ricardo Couto, serves as interim governor.
